name: 作業データベースの表示切替
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0046 Japanese database view-switching toolbar, one component only.
Original image1 full screen and image2 crop are PRIMARY authority for icon glyph anatomy, stroke/optical weights, proportions, spacing, grouping, visible controls and fine details. Mock image3 is SECONDARY Japanese wording/layout guide; restore all source controls it omitted.
Single wide compact toolbar on pure white. Left: FIVE tabs with leading small authentic view icons. Exact labels:「案件別」「今の期間」「未着手」「自分の作業」「担当者」. First tab selected, thin forest-green underline. Original table/grid icons on tabs1,3,4,5; original kanban-columns icon on tab2, NOT mock person/symbol substitutes. Then thin plus to add view.
Right aligned:「絞り込み」「並べ替え」, outline magnifier search icon, horizontal ellipsis, then small PRIMARY forest-green gradient split button「新規作成」with right segment downward chevron and subtle divider. All these controls visible; new button was missing from mock. Keep original balance: tabs grouped left, tools and button grouped right, plenty of separating space.
Meiryo Regular14/24, zero tracking; no display heading or heavy type. Utility icons coherent slate #526173; selected state forest green; primary button gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with legible white text and chevron, gentle edge/shadow, no gloss. No tinted page, no extra card, rows, titles or invented fields. White overall canvas, compact readable sharp UI.
reviewNotes: Five Japanese tabs, original table/kanban glyph types, add-view plus, filter/sort/search/ellipsis and omitted split-create button restored and inspected. Selected underline/primary action forest green. Exact font/vector and runtime behavior unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
